name: Trump: The Dating Simulator
source:
They storm the capital.....To praise his name ....And defend his honor ....

He has his own army ....He has this country.... But can he have you? ...And you, him?

 Play now to find out. 

 Engage in strategic navigation of complex interactions, Distressing decisions, Tender moments , And advanced gameplay

[From [url=https://efpelle.itch.io/trump-dating-sim]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
他們衝向首都……為讚頌他的名……為捍衛他的榮耀……

他有自己的軍隊……他擁有這個國家……但他能擁有你嗎？……而你，能擁有他嗎？

現在就來玩，找到答案。

動用策略，周旋於複雜的交往中，做出令人痛苦的決定，體驗溫柔的瞬間，還有進階玩法。
